headline: Why haven't I found my soulmate where I am?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NO LOCATION, EVER — never place him, never name a setting, never 'someone you already know', never 'crossed paths before'. 🔴 NO PROXIMITY CLAIM: 'closer than you think' is the INCUMBENT cards-soulmate's answer, and if this family repeats it the two landers are the same lander while the dashboard still shows two rows. 🔴 NO STRATEGY — get out there, put yourself out there, stop looking, work on yourself first, 'it will happen when you…' are all directives. 🔴 Never her fault: no walls, no baggage, no standards, no 'too picky'.

Finding: an absence is not always CAUSED, so there is no culprit to hand her — and she has been the only suspect in her own case for a long time.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the cup on his table is gold, and it's empty.
You asked why you've not found your soulmate yet. Your hand went to the maker.
So there's no wrong turning to find, dear. You didn't miss it.
And look at the cup. It's empty, and nobody emptied it.
But you've been hunting for whose fault this is, dear.
That's why a quiet year feels like a mark against you, dear.
Let me look closer at what has been sitting in the empty place…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — there's nothing under his head but empty space.
You asked why you've not found your soulmate yet. Your hand went to the card that waits.
So a pause needs no guilty party, dear. Yours has none.
And nothing is happening on this card. Nobody made it stop, dear.
But you went looking for someone to blame, dear, and you picked you.
That's why you go over old choices at night, dear, one by one.
Let me look closer at what has been sitting across your path…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the cliff face below him is striped orange and grey.
You asked why you've not found your soulmate yet. Your hand went to the one still walking.
So you're still on the road, dear. That's all this card says.
And he's mid-walk, dear, and nobody has told him he's late.
But no one is to blame for a road that isn't finished, dear.
That's why the blame never fits. You've carried one that was never yours, dear.
Let me look closer at what has been weighing on this road…
